mentions.name: Kulikuli Translate
mentions.description: Web version of the author's translation app. It provides machine translation with better quality than Google/DeepL and includes a reverse-translation feature that translates the result back so users can double-check it.
mentions.problem: Existing translators like Google/DeepL offer lower translation quality and no easy way for users to verify the results.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://kulikuli.app/translate I'm building a web version of my app, which has better quality than Google/DeepL and also translates the result in reversed for users to double check.
